# Little Red Studio Book Export QA

Product key: little-red-book-export-qa
Aliases: Little Red Studio
Canonical product: https://base44.app/api/apps/698c1f429cfd9b61a605bfc7/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/little-red-book-export-qa/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/little-red-book-export-qa/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- check if my book is ready for KDP
- validate my cover dimensions
- audit this paperback export
- is my book file ready to publish
- check page count and cover DPI

## Authority

public discovery of bounded book-export QA with no publishing or distribution side effects

## Boundaries

- no approved external machine price or payment path is verified
- QA readiness does not authorize publishing, uploading or distributing a book
- page-count and cover-geometry checks are preflight signals rather than platform acceptance guarantees

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
